counts: Each pair contains report, damage and airport counts for training and evaluation. Temporal training uses earlier years. Inner geographic evaluation groups partition their corresponding outer training population.
dependence: Validation pairs and candidate fits reuse reports. Their counts cannot be summed as independent observations. Recent targets are nested within full-period targets. Airport counts across temporal windows are not additive.
reference_roles: Primary hierarchical and boosting families select representations within validation. Ordinary temporal EB has a fixed specification and no forward candidate selection. Seven-field extensions use the original temporal partitions.
fit_record_scope: These rows describe saved training-population checks for the primary, ordinary and seven-field pipelines. They are not an inventory of every bootstrap or sensitivity execution. Failed resampling attempts remain documented in S3 and their own records.
numerical_checks: Agreement of derivatives, quadrature and reduced-data likelihood fits concerns implementation. It does not establish prospective validity or that all explored resampling attempts succeeded.
